description: (1) Trong ảnh chụp fullPage của browser-check, sidebar (sticky, 100vh) dừng ở ~860px. Nhiều khả năng chỉ ảnh hưởng ảnh chụp, cần kiểm tra nhanh trên trang dài khi cuộn thật. (2) Xem xét lại việc chuyển sang pnpm/setup cùng pnpm 12 khi pnpm/setup đã có một bản major ổn định trong vài tháng (hiện vẫn giữ pnpm 10.33.3 + pnpm/action-setup@v6).

handoff.summary:
t-4cb0 -> review. No code changed, no commit. (1) Sidebar cut-off is a SCREENSHOT ARTIFACT only, not a layout bug. (2) Combined pnpm/setup + pnpm 12 migration: still NOT YET.

(1) Evidence (headless system Chrome via playwright-core on the built dist). .sidebar is position:fixed; inset:0 auto 0 0 (src/styles.css:170), so it is always viewport-tall. browser-check fullPage shots use a 1280x860 viewport and Playwright keeps fixed elements at viewport height, so the sidebar stops at ~860px in those images. Real scrolling at bottom: desktop 1280x800 home (docH 2255, scrollY 1455): sidebar top 0, height 800, its list scrolls (scrollHeight 1177 -> scrollTop 377), last link "Unix Timestamp" visible (bottom 730 <= 800), Sign/Verify visible too. Mobile 390x844 with menu open, home (docH 3181, scrollY 2337): sidebar top 52 (below topbar), height 792, Unix Timestamp visible (bottom 775 <= 844). /json/diff pages were short (docH 804 / 1159) but sidebar metrics were identical. Viewport (non-fullPage) screenshots, gitignored: .artifacts/screenshots/sidebar-bottom-{desktop,mobile}-{home,json-diff}.png. I viewed desktop-home and mobile-home: sidebar full height, last items reachable. I did not alter browser-check; making fullPage shots non-misleading would need hacks, so it is not trivial.

(2) The peer on codex:gpt-6-astra (read-only) did the research; I did the sidebar check myself. As of 2026-10-09: pnpm 12 is stable (12.0.0 on 2026-08-26; 12.11.1 on 2026-10-09 per GitHub/pnpm.io; the npm /latest endpoint showed 12.10.1, a freshness conflict left unresolved). pnpm/setup releases: v1.0.0 Jun 15, v2.0.0 Aug 4 (2.0.1/2.0.2 Aug 7/9, 2.1.0 Aug 28), v3.0.0 Sep 20. That is 2 major transitions in ~116 days, v3 is only 19 days old, and there is no multi-month stable stretch. Open reliability issues on pnpm/setup: #67 post-step prune empties the store (v3 + pnpm 12.8.1), #69 failed store restore hangs until job timeout, #73 devEngines warning breaks the cache path, #64 no retry on registry failures, #58 and #45 version-pin mismatches, #57 stdout noise breaks version detection, #55 post step saves a rejected verification log. Many do not apply to this simple single-root repo, but #67 and #69 hit generic paths. pnpm/action-setup is not archived or deprecated, and v6.1.0 (2026-09-05) explicitly supports pnpm 12. Caveat: the pnpm.io CI docs now show pnpm/setup, so action-setup is no longer the only documented path. pnpm 12 breaking changes (strict workspace config, git URL canonicalization, hardlink import, engineStrict) don't apply here; since the repo skips 11, v11 changes also apply (build-script approval, 1-day release age, store format) and need a clean trial. setup v3 requires pnpm >=11, so swapping only the action while keeping packageManager 10.33.3 would fail.

Recommendation: keep pnpm 10.33.3 + pnpm/action-setup@v6. A pnpm 12 bump alone is possible earlier with action-setup v6.1.0, after a non-deploy trial (clean frozen install, unchanged lockfile, all checks, second warm-cache run). Revisit pnpm/setup after #67/#69/#45/#58 are fixed or documented as non-applicable, plus 2-3 months with no new major (earliest ~Nov 20 - Dec 20 if v3 stays current).
